origin.description: Drops leading and trailing spaces, tabs, carriage returns, and newlines. The color open and close stay.
origin.usage: trimws_ctl(x, which = c("both", "left", "right"), whitespace = "[ \\t\\r\\n]", warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE), term.cap = getOption("fansi.term.cap", dflt_term_cap()), ctl = "all", normalize = getOption("fansi.normalize", FALSE))
origin.details: Drops leading and trailing spaces, tabs, carriage returns, and newlines. The color open and close stay. An omitted wrap width is 72, which is 0.9 times the default R width of 80.

translation.description: Drops leading and trailing spaces, tabs, carriage returns, and newlines. The color open and close stay.
translation.usage: trimws_ctl(x, which="both", whitespace="[ \\t\\r\\n]", warn=None, term_cap=None, ctl="all", normalize=None)
translation.details: Drops leading and trailing spaces, tabs, carriage returns, and newlines. The color open and close stay. An omitted wrap width is 72. A string is one element. None is a missing string. Dotted R names are written with underscores.
translation.example:
from fansi.trimws_ctl import trimws_ctl
print(trimws_ctl(" \033[31m\thello world\t\033[39m ", warn=False)[0])
